query: Beyond the three-case pilot, what generalization benchmarks and metrics will we use to evaluate domain robustness across different concrete mixes, scales, and novel damage modalities?

response.query: Beyond the three-case pilot, what generalization benchmarks and metrics will we use to evaluate domain robustness across different concrete mixes, scales, and novel damage modalities?
response.answer: We will use statistical metrics like variance analysis and robustness testing across different scales and damage types to evaluate domain robustness. Key benchmarks include failure rate consistency and performance variability under novel conditions.
